notes.title: Hotfix 2.1 is LIVE | Save-related Issues
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Loves 🫶[/p][p][/p][h3]Hotfix 2.1[/h3][p]Hotfix 2.1 is LIVE on PC![/p][p]This patch addresses critical save-related issues surfaced with Hotfix 2. Saves are handled differently across various platforms, manifesting the issue in several ways. On steam, this tends to leave players stuck on the loading screen. [/p][p]This issue should now be resolved ✅[/p][p][/p][h3]SPECS[/h3][p]In addition, we have aimed to get to the bottom of SPECS discrepancies and have worked hard to get this complex system right. As an effect players might see changes in their score, but that has been done to more accurately capture the intended state. [/p][p]If SPECS are lost from New Game+, we recommend reloading a save from right before this patch, initiating the epilogue, and starting again from there. notes.title: Date Everything! Demo Going Offline
notes.notes: [h3]Hello, Loves 🥰 [/h3][p][/p][p]First dates don’t last forever, so we’re removing the Date Everything! Steam demo at 6 AM PST, Friday 27th June — 24 hours from now. [/p][p][/p][p]When we first decided to create a demo for Date Everything! the intention was always to make this available exclusively as a way for players to try the game before release, and we can't thank you enough for trying the world of Date Everything!  [/p][p][/p][p]But now that we have released some hotfixes and made the game even better with hundreds of Daemons squashed, we feel it's best you try the full game for yourself with all our improvements – and, of course, the ability to make use of your save data, rather than replay the opening hours again. [/p][p] [/p][h3]What’s Next? [/h3][p][/p][p]Following Hotfix 1, we’re working on our next patch — Hotfix 2 🥰 [/p][p]This patch addresses a whole host of issues reported at launch, including blockers with Arma, Beverly, Scandalabra, and more! [/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate your patience while we've investigated these issues, and we'll have more Hotfix 2 details to share soon! 💖 [/p][p] [/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201320/Date_Everything/"][/dynamiclink][/h3]

notes.title: Date Everything! Hotfix Patch 1 - Out Now on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello loves,

[b]We've just released our first Hotfix Patch for Date Everything! on Steam! [/b]

Before we get into the patch details, we want to thank you for all your support since our sandbox dating-sim launched earlier in the week. 🫶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120785/9429c000f14a24499236868d77d4bac61c179c47.png[/img][/p]

Hotfix Patch 1 for Steam brings fixes to community-reported bugs, including [b]a fix to the Date-a-dex scrolling[/b] sound effect issue, [b]fixes to blocks for the Hate Everything[/b] Achievement and [b]✨ more! ✨[/b]

We hope you enjoy Hotfix Patch 1 and have an even smoother experience with our 100+ dateables in Date Everything! 💞

[h2]⚙️ Hotfix Patch 1 - Patch Notes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue with the Date-a-dex, where the scrolling sound effect would persist on the Date-a-dex menu screen.
[*] Fixed blocking issues, affecting the Hate Everything Achievement. Fixes below contain achievement spoilers, which have been [spoiler]spoiler tagged[/spoiler]. These fixes include:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Abel's Hate ending, [spoiler]where players were unable to obtain this if they had already experienced the Hate ending with Dasha.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue with obtaining Jerry's Hate ending, which causes Cam to break.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Hero Hime, [spoiler]where players were unable to unlock the Hero Hime when following the the 100 Hate Endings path.[/spoiler][/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some players was unable to obtain friendship status with Timothy.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Scandalabra, [spoiler]where the candle kiss animation failed for some players.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue with Jerry's carousel, which did not appear for every ending.
[*] Fixed an issue with Chairemi, where the unique friendship pose for Chairemi was missing.
[*] Fixed a font issue where incorrect letters would appear in one of Dasha's text dialogue lines.
[*] Fixed various VO-text mismatches and typos. [/list]
[h3]Player Support[/h3]
If you run into any issues with Date Everything! please reach out to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2201320/discussions/1/]Support Team via the Report a Problem forum.[/url]

[h2]Our next Hotfix patch[/h2]
We are currently working on Hotfix 2, which addresses a WHOLE HOST of issues that came up once 150,000+ of you all started playing at once. Hotfix 2 will fix hundreds of bugs, most especially the blockers with characters like Arma, Beverly, Scandalabra, Gaia, Rebel, Maggie, and more.

Thanks for your patience and for reporting all of these in detail, so that we can squash more bugs you've reported and make our sandbox dating-sim the most pristine experience for you!

[h2]Steam Stats 👀[/h2]
Connie is thrilled to share our Date Everything! Steam launch stats with you...

[b]🗽 #5 in America
🌍 #10 Worldwide[/b]

We've been blown away by your incredible support - this is all thanks to you! 🥹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120785/f9bb1d07b4c8efdcd35cc1a0593edac472d0e5b9.png[/img]

That's all for now loves... but we'll see you very soon with more Date Everything! news 🫶

notes.title: Date Everything claims to be a dating sim, but it doesn't love or understand its own genre
notes.notes: Romantic games are one of the most overlooked successes in all of gaming. There are million-selling series spanning decades amongst them, and the loosely defined genre thrives on Steam in all its beautiful forms, encompassing everything from breezy pop star fantasies and summer adventures to hot gothic stories. Date Everything, a comedic "sandbox dating simulator" where I romance tables and lamps thanks to a pair of hi-tech glasses, has a lot of competition—and a lot of work to do if it wants to convince me that the jokes here aren't aimed at the genre, or at me for playing it... Read more.

notes.title: Date Everything!—ish | Demo now available!
notes.notes:
Hello loves,

[h3]Enter the world of Date Everything! RIGHT NOW with the demo on Steam![/h3]

You have two (2) in-game days to date, hate and friend the objects of your desires. Each day is limited to five (5) charges, you can interact with five (5) individual Dateables per day, totalling ten (10) charges. In addition, there is a one-time-only Tutorial Day where you can meet Skylar, Phoenicia, Dorian, Maggie, and Betty as they explain how to play the game! 😍

Now... Once you hit your charge limit, you will be met with a thank-you screen with release information. 

Date. Sleep. Reset. Repeat. 🏠

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eQTKFiL.png[/img]


[h2]Content Restrictions[/h2]

[list]
[*] You cannot date Dateables for more than 2 days
[*] You can unlock two (2) additional unique endings by leaving the house
[*] Select number of Dateables will not be available in the Demo
[*] Access to the Attic will be restricted in the Demo
[*] Achievements will not be available in the Demo
[*] Save Data will not carry over to the Full Release
[/list]

notes.title: Steve Blum as Abel the Table and more! Less than a month until launch 💖
notes.notes:
Hello loves,

You are less than a month away from waking up in a lovely home full of love and affection! 🏡💓

In the meantime, we still have [i]a lot[/i] of dateables to reveal. Here's a recap of some of our latest intros: 

[h2]Abel 🎙️ Steve Blum[/h2]

Abel is happy to support your needs, rain or shine, and most people in the house consider him a steady, calming influence.

https://youtu.be/qJYFu81DH_g?si=snKGcvs2Rf5W5zOE

notes.title: Date Everything! June 17th 2025
notes.notes:
Hello loves, a mysterious parcel is scheduled to arrive at your door soon! 

Get ready to fall in love with the most enormous cast of stars ever in gaming! 💓

[h3]📆 Date Everything! launches June 17 on Steam! [/h3]

[i]Watch our new trailer where Skylar (voiced by Felicia Day) explains how Dateviators work (warning quite saucy language inside)[/i]

[previewyoutube=MAD1r-1oQ2w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What on earth is Date Everything!?[/h3]

Glad you asked!

Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator that lets you explore a world where even the most ordinary objects hold romantic potential. Equipped with “Dateviator” glasses, you can chat with everything from the laundry basket to the air itself, discovering unique personalities and outcomes.  

The physical edition will  launch across all platforms later in 2025 and more info can be found on the [url=https://dateeverything.com/]Date Everything! website.[/url]

[h3]Date Everything! features: [/h3]

[list]
[*] 100 fully voiced dateable characters for players to fall madly in love with. 
[*] Branching dialogue that leads to multiple endings for each character. 
[*] Over 4 hours of music with each dateable character featuring their own theme. 
[*] 11,000+ hand-drawn images. 
[*] 1.2 million words and 70,000 voicelines. 
[*] A fully interactive 3d overworld that changes based on choices made in the playthrough. 
[*] Full voice acting with a huge cast of familiar voices, including Felicia Day (Supernatural, Fallout), Ben Starr (Final Fantasy 16), Critical Role star Matt Mercer, BAFTA Award winners Laura Bailey (The Last of Us), Neil Newbon (Baldurs Gate 3), Troy Baker (Indiana Jones and The Great Circle), Ashley Burch (Horizon series) and more! 
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mcyBNuw.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Love awaits....[/h3]

A cheeky, wildly interactive, new dating sim from familiar voice actors turned developers Ray Chase, Robbie Daymond, Max Mittelman and Amanda Hufford!

Date Everything is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice-acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

[h3]Get ready to Date Everything! 💋[/h3]

notes.title: Date Everything! Now Releases June 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120785/a9e04119808465f5a9aec8cb79f3695a9401a77c.png[/img]

To our fellow Dateviators,

Since we last updated you on development, we have been extremely hard at work finishing work on Date Everything! And at this point I can confidently say that we have reached that point where the game is complete to a standard that we feel reached our goals with no compromise in our bonkers artistic vision. 
 
However... I was too confident that we could properly test ALL the wild amount of content and pathing that exists in this massive game, and unfortunately we ran out of time on our current (and yet so appropriate) release date of February 14th, 2025. 
 
Our bug list is finally starting to dwindle down as QA gets through the labyrinthine story pathing, but to submit our game in the state with so many outstanding glitches would be doing you a disservice. 
 
[b]Date Everything! will now release June 2025.[/b] And while it isn't quite as sexy a date as Valentine's Day, we hope we can bring new sexiness to June evermore... 
 
Before signing off on this typical game delay announcement, I'd like to update you on three things: 
 
[list]
[*] We've been fairly coy on revealing too much as we've gotten through this winter, but please look forward to many many more character and VA reveals over the coming months, along with sneak peeks of playthroughs. 

[*] Our final count now that we have finished development: 1,602,572 words, 74,053 voiced lines, 27,924 choices, 13,090 images, 5 hour and 6 minute soundtrack. 

[*] You can date of course the bugs, by the way. Their name is Daemon and I have a Love/Hate relationship with them currently.
[/list]

[b]- Ray Chase | Lead Designer[/b]

notes.title: Date Everything! on Valentine's Day! Launching February 14th 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋

The interest and love you've shown for Date Everything! has been incredible! We're overwhelmed by your excitement for the game and can't wait for you all to experience the love, friendship, and conflict that our dateables have to offer. 

Making a game with 100 unique voiceable characters has been challenging and rewarding. We've got an abundance of fresh, interesting playstyle choices that lead to original, thoughtful, and one-of-a-kind stories. Variety has been one of our guiding principles through development and we still have SO MUCH left to show you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sbdJh4K.png[/img]

As many of you know, Date Everything! was due to release this month — but we're going to need a little more time to polish and give you the best possible game we can.

Thanks to your wishlists and support, we've been given some breathing room to avoid crunch. 

[h3][b]The new release date for Date Everything is... 

February 14th 2025 — Valentine's Day! 💞[/b]
